cards.card_text: So Joshua says, "get rid of the foreign gods among you and incline your hearts to the LORD, the God of Israel." Promising with foreign gods still AMONG you is like me swearing off cookie dough with dough still stuck in my mustache.
cards.verse_text: “Now, therefore,” he said, “get rid of the foreign gods among you and incline your hearts to the LORD, the God of Israel.”
